2577-6763-7084-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-6763-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1517-2134-4050-8240.easyPrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture's third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1517-2134-4050-8240.description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Grandmother Goby and The Mirari Conjecture trigger.
Resolve the Grandmother Goby trigger, countering Bond of Inisght and creating four 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Resolve the The Mirari Conjecture trigger, copying Bond of Insight.
Resolve the copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards and then returning the original Bond of Insight and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the four Merfolk tokens, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

141-1070-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-6798.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-5060-5258-5618-6495.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-5060-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-5060-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-6495-7211.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7211.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2921-7192.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

2111-6792-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

372-4783-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, creating a Blood token.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Hellkite Courser and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Repeat.

1545-1895-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-1895-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

900-7124-7653.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block The Incredible Hulk.
900-7124-7653.description:
Deal combat damage using The Incredible Hulk. 
Sword of Feast and Famine triggers, untapping all lands you control.
During the end of combat step, activate Desert's second ability by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then untapping it and causing you to gain an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1829-2173-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

216-1618-2440-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings
216-1618-2440-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
216-1618-2440-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

147-5147-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5147-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5147-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

3259-5621-6628--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3259-5621-6628--85--106.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-3967-5470-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-5902-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2457-4094-4289-7297.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-2921-4452-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2921-4452-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1887-3899-4552-4832.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

2014-2921-3055.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

5670-6291-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
5670-6291-6458.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6291-6458.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

56-789-4054-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-789-4054-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-789-4054-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

804-5256-5756.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Sakashima the Impostor's power.
Repeat.

678-4192-5256-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-4192-5256-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Circling Vultures' power.
Repeat.

252-2963-4312-4554.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U}{U} the first turn, and {G}{U} available each extra turn
252-2963-4312-4554.notablePrerequisites: Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
252-2963-4312-4554.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {4}{W}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Teferi, causing it to enter the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

826-1486-3459-4461.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem and Amoeboid Changeling do not have summoning sickness.
826-1486-3459-4461.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's first ability by tapping it, causing Battered Golem to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Battered Golem by paying {R} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Battered Golem ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

262-643-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
262-643-2534.description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield as Pirates due to Maskwood Nexus, Coercive Recruiter triggers four times.
Resolve the first three triggers, causing you to gain control of up to three other creatures and untap them.
Resolve the last trigger, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this during each of your turns to gain control of all creatures during your turn.

2348-2882-3819-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two land cards in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
2348-2882-3819-4050-5220.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Nature's Revolt and Infinite Reflection.
When the land enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land, adding one mana of any color.
When the land dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the land on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put any other land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1348-2404-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three creatures.
1348-2404-4657.description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra and preventing all damage done to, and dealt by, it this turn.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat from step 2.

1124-2034-3836-4853-5002.notablePrerequisites: Urza, Lord Protector and The Mightstone and Weakstone melded into Urza, Planeswalker.
1124-2034-3836-4853-5002.description:
Activate Urza, Planeswalker's third loyalty ability by putting no loyalty counters on it, creating two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Soldiers die, triggering Dross Scorpion twice, untapping The Chain Veil and any other artifact you control.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Repeat.

637-2452-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Archghoul of Thraben, adding {R}.
Mortuary and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Archghoul of Thraben on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Archghoul of Thraben from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Cast Archghoul of Thraben by paying {0}.
Repeat.
